RcppOptimLib: An Interface to the C++ Numerical Optimization Library 'OptimLib'

Source: R/RcppOptimLib-package.R
RcppOptimLib-package.Rd

Ships the header-only version of Keith O'Hara's 'OptimLib' (https://optimlib.readthedocs.io/) so that R users and other R packages can use its optimization algorithms (BFGS, L-BFGS, conjugate gradient, gradient descent, Nelder-Mead, differential evolution, particle swarm, and root finding) from C++ code via 'Rcpp' and 'RcppArmadillo'.

Details

There are two ways to use the package:

  1. From C++ (recommended): add LinkingTo: RcppOptimLib, Rcpp, RcppArmadillo to your package's DESCRIPTION and PKG_LIBS = $(LAPACK_LIBS) $(BLAS_LIBS) $(FLIBS) to its src/Makevars (or use // [[Rcpp::depends(RcppOptimLib, RcppArmadillo)]] in a sourceCpp() file), then #include <RcppOptimLib.h> and call the optim:: routines directly on Armadillo vectors.

  2. From R: call the demonstration wrappers such as optim_sphere_bfgs(), optim_ackley_de(), optimlib_bfgs() and optimlib_nm(). The latter two accept plain R functions as objectives via callbacks.
